content.title: Daily music journal: one host-scheduled instance
content.summary: An illustrative private text/audio daily instance; the host resolves local-day dates and may allow backfill.
content.setup: The host supplies effective actors and resolved phase dates.
content.participant: Follow the prompt and submit one accepted contribution in each phase for which you are eligible.
content.completion: The host decides dates and closing for each daily instance; no runtime calendar, streak or missed-day penalty is imposed.
content.access: Private visibility is an example choice, not a universal journal default.

provenance.credit: Harmonomicon digital example; the runbook defines the selected software rules.
provenance.rights: Original example description. Rights to participant contributions are not specified by this package.

steps.prompt: Record a practice note or a ready audio clip.
